class.name: NNBTRandomSelector
class.brief_description: Tries child branches in a random order until one succeeds, or fails if all fail.
class.description: Works like [NNBTSelector], but shuffles its enabled children at the start of each run so the AI varies which fallback option it tries first. Returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] as soon as one child succeeds, [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] while a child is running, and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] if all fail.
